description: NZ Properties: Property-Building Reference is a dataset listed in LINZ Data Service (data.linz.govt.nz), New Zealand, an open data portal, published or maintained by NZ Properties. This dataset provides a non-spatial relationship between unitofpropertyid and buildingid from the NZ Building Outlines dataset. This table provides a PDMF-compliant link between property and buildings. The data is updated on a weekly basis. Coverage: New Zealand. The portal files it under the publisher NZ Properties. Its tags are New Zealand. It offers 1 resource(s) in table. The portal shows 2026-09-24 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the portal's own catalogue entry (title, description, tags, licence, formats and dates) read through its API, so the data files were not opened, their contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-nz-linz-portal.
